0.name: Mutation (3–60)
0.body: The energy of renewal through limitation. Change comes through constraint that eventually opens new ground. Patient in the middle, breakthrough at the end.

1.name: The Beat (14–2)
1.body: The Channel of Empowering — direction in life born of work that has resources behind it. Identity moved by the sacral.

2.name: Inspiration (1–8)
2.body: The voice of the individual creative — sharing authentic expression. When you say it, others resonate.

3.name: Structuring (43–23)
3.body: Unique insight translated into language others can grasp. But if the timing is off, it sounds strange.

4.name: Awareness (61–24)
4.body: Constantly thinking about the mystery and the answer that emerges. Inner inspiration that won't quiet — needs guarding from overthinking.

5.name: Openness (22–12)
5.body: Social charisma with mood. When the mood is right, you can touch many people through honest expression.

6.name: Emoting (39–55)
6.body: Provocateur of spirit. Creativity born of mood — can become art or drama, depending on awareness.

7.name: Struggle (38–28)
7.body: The energy to fight for something meaningful. Knowing what's worth fighting for — not opposing everything.

8.name: The Brainwave (57–20)
8.body: Intuition that lands directly as voice. You know and you speak, with no long process between.

9.name: Perfected Form (57–10)
9.body: Survival instinct lifting self-love. The body knows how to live elegantly.

10.name: Awakening (10–20)
10.body: Commitment to your own path in this moment. "I am who I am" — said and lived.

11.name: Community (37–40)
11.body: The channel of tribal bargain — I give, you give back. Healthy reciprocity in close relationships.

12.name: Synthesis (19–49)
12.body: Sensitivity to the community's needs. Knows when the tribe needs something — or when it needs change.

13.name: Surrender (26–44)
13.body: The transmitter of past lessons. Teaches from experience — not theory.

14.name: Money Line (21–45)
14.body: The materialist — controlling resources for the tribe. A natural manager of supplies.

15.name: Preservation (27–50)
15.body: Caretaking instinct — protecting the vulnerable. The instinct to guard family or those under your care.

16.name: Mating (59–6)
16.body: Reproductive channel — attraction born of emotion and intimacy. Not just sexual: how your energy merges with another's.

17.name: Maturation (42–53)
17.body: The channel of cycles — energy that opens and closes them. Begin, sustain, complete.

18.name: Discovery (29–46)
18.body: Say yes and the body commits. Discovery comes from a yes the body already confirmed.

19.name: Concentration (9–52)
19.body: Deep focus with the right pressure. The capacity for detail others can't hold.

20.name: Rhythm (5–15)
20.body: Rhythm that resonates with nature and humanity. A body that knows its timing without needing to be told.

21.name: The Alpha (7–31)
21.body: Leadership appointed through group recognition. Not taking power — power being given.

22.name: Acceptance (62–17)
22.body: The voice of organization — logical opinion grounded in facts and details.

23.name: Logic (4–63)
23.body: Mental — questioning and answering forever. Patterns tested over time become mental authority for the community.

24.name: The Wavelength (16–48)
24.body: Talent with depth. A skill polished over time becomes expression that lands fast.

25.name: Judgment (18–58)
25.body: A sensor for what patterns aren't working, plus the strength to set them right. Constructive critique.

26.name: The Prodigal (13–33)
26.body: A listener who holds stories. Collective experience turning into lesson through reflection.

27.name: Curiosity (11–56)
27.body: A storyteller with ideas. Mental imagery that opens exploration without needing concrete action.

28.name: Abstraction (64–47)
28.body: Confusion until clarity arrives on its own. Reflection on the past becomes the lesson.

29.name: Transitoriness (35–36)
29.body: Boredom until a new crisis. Seeking new experience but often shadowed by emptiness.

30.name: Recognition (30–41)
30.body: The channel of fantasy — imagination about the emotional experience yet to come.

31.name: Charisma (34–20)
31.body: Pure power expressed in the present. "I am" shown through pure action.

32.name: Power (34–57)
32.body: Power used in line with instinct. The risk: hard to stop because the body keeps firing.

33.name: Exploration (34–10)
33.body: Self-exploration through being yourself. Identity fused with pure power.

34.name: Initiation (25–51)
34.body: Spiritual competition — the channel that brings others into a new level of awareness through shock.

35.name: Transformation (32–54)
35.body: Ambition connected to material transformation. Drive to level up with the body's support.
